description:
The API keys of a deployment, published once under the storage root and
read by every reader of it. A key is the keyed hash of its secret; the
artifact never holds a secret, a name or a reader token.
title: ApiKeysArtifact

SchemaVersion.description: Contract schema version `<major>.<minor>`. Readers accept any minor of their major and reject other majors.

subject.description:
`key:<64 lowercase hex>`, the keyed hash of the secret. The same hash
binds the key in the identity artifact of each namespace.

namespace_prefix.description: The key acts only in namespaces whose name starts with this.

ApiKeyRole.description:
What an API key may do over HTTP. `list`, `write` and `admin` name roles
of routes that do not exist yet; a key holds them so that the routes need
no new key format.
